changeSet.sql: UPDATE bill_account_amounts SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE is_deferred = true AND status <> 'CONFIRMED';

UPDATE bill_account_amounts current_month SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE status = 'NOT_CONFIRMED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bill_account_amounts previous_month WHERE previous_month.bill_account_id = current_month.bill_account_id AND previous_month.household_id = current_month.household_id AND previous_month.is_deferred = true AND ( (previous_month.year = current_month.year AND previous_month.month = current_month.month - 1) OR (previous_month.month = 12 AND previous_month.year = current_month.year - 1 AND current_month.month = 1) ) );
